description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Affiliate' class within the Opencart	extbackslash Catalog	extbackslash Model	extbackslash	extbackslash Account namespace. The class provides methods for managing affiliate data such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving affiliate information, as well as logging reports related to affiliates.
external_files: Opencart	extbackslash System	extbackslash Engine	extbackslash Model

classes.name: Affiliate
classes.description: A model class for handling affiliate-related database interactions including CRUD operations and report logging within the OpenCart system.

methods.name: addAffiliate
methods.description: Adds a new affiliate record for a given customer ID with provided data, also handles approval process if enabled.

methods.name: editAffiliate
methods.description: Updates existing affiliate details for a customer specified by customer ID with new data.

methods.name: deleteAffiliate
methods.description: Deletes an affiliate record and related reports for a given customer ID.

methods.name: getAffiliate
methods.description: Retrieves affiliate data for a specified customer ID, including decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getAffiliateByTracking
methods.description: Fetches affiliate details based on a provided tracking code.

methods.name: addReport
methods.description: Logs an affiliate report entry with customer ID, IP, and optional country.

methods.name: deleteReports
methods.description: Removes all report entries for a specific customer ID.
